## Contributing to spessasynth_lib

First, I want to thank you for wanting to help develop spessasynth_lib.
I really appreciate your contribution :-)

Here are some tips about contributing:

### Reporting a bug

Use the GitHub issue forms and please avoid using the "Blank" template unless absolutely necessary.

### Contributing a patch/enhancement

Fork the repository, make your changes and run `npm run build` before opening a pull request.
It runs ESLint, the type check and the full build, and it needs to pass.
The [documentation](https://spessasus.github.io/spessasynth_lib/) describes the public API.

### License notice
